gap: No result ChatGPT got gives today's maker-store price for any kit that ships with both a battery and a panel in the box. Anker's own US store charges $999.99 for the C1000 Gen 2 + 100 W bifacial kit, not the $709.99 on ChatGPT's card. On 2026-11-15, searches of the EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, BLUETTI and Jackery US stores returned no STREAM, Solarbank, Balco or SolarVault product.
standout_why: balconysolarkits.us/kits (cited) already says STREAM Ultra was removed from EcoFlow's US store in Oct 2026 and is Utah-only, and that Balco, Solarbank and SolarVault are not sold in the US. It also lists Zendure as sold out. solutionenergy.com/solar/balcony/with-battery (cited) prices only STREAM Ultra (about $1,399), Zendure (about $3,932, sold out) and DELTA 3 Plus (about $669). It gives 'check price' for the C1000 Gen 2 + 200W, AC180 + 200W and RIVER 3 Plus kits. wattbalcon.fr could not be opened (certificate error). The rivals already cover availability. What they lack is maker-store prices today for the kits that really come with a battery and a panel.
decides: This supports the pick on our page (dealectric.com/balcony-solar-system-with-battery-us): a US shopper who wants battery and panel in one box today can only buy a power station plus panel kit, which runs appliances directly and does not feed the home's wiring. Of ChatGPT's five card products, only the Anker C1000 Gen 2 kit is buyable from its maker's US store, and there it costs $999.99. That is more than our listed BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W ($769 per our page, not re-read today) and ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + 400 W ($948 per our page). Those two pack more battery and more panel, so the Anker card loses on price per Wh and on panel size.
